transcript: Speaker A: आज का चैलेंज बहुत सिंपल है, अपनी फेवरेट मूवी के बारे में 20 सेकंड इंग्लिश में बोलो, बस। [Today's challenge is very simple, speak about your favorite movie in English for 20 seconds, that's it.] Speaker A: भाई साहब, आपकी फेवरेट मूवी? [Brother, your favorite movie?] Speaker B: 3 Idiots. summary: The host challenges people on the street to speak about their favorite movie in English for 20 seconds. While others struggle, one man speaks fluently and credits his success to the English Seekho app. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
